ClientResponses.Response:
We appreciate your feedback. We are so sorry to hear your food is sticking to the grates. We are happy to help. 

With regards to food sticking, we have the following recommendations:
 
1. You can oil the food directly, but we do not recommend applying any kind of oil directly to the grates. 
 
2. Make sure you're giving your food enough time per side. Food will naturally start to release from the grates when close to flipping time.
 
3. If using a marinade, try to get as much excess liquid off as possible before placing the food on the grill.
 
4. If using a sauce of any kind, wait until the last 5 minutes or so to apply.
 
5. We recommend cleaning your cooking grates every time you use your grill. Simply preheat the grill on high for 15 minutes with the lid closed and then brush the grates clean with a Weber Stainless Steel Grill Brush.

Hopefully, this is helpful. Our Care team will be reaching out to follow up. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber grills

Results.ReviewText: It is ok, it is my first Weber and there are some features that are missing from this price point.  The ash collection and disposal system is much better than other grills I have had. When you go look at grills in the 200-300 price range most have attached tables or shelves and most have a away to adjust the height between the food and the charcoal.  The adjustable rack is not overly important but you don't know how much you miss attached table/shelves to set plates or pans on to load or unload food until it is gone.  Also the grill seems to be rather topheavy I have had it blown over a couple times in just normal daily coastal weather. I am not sure whether or not I would purchase it again so far not over overly impressed with it, it is just ok.
Results.Title: It is just ok

Results.ReviewText: We have a few outdoor cooking platforms - BGE, Blackstone and propane - but it's hard to beat a simple old-fashioned charcoal grill. I've been very happy with this grill at the price point. It's easy to control the temperature with the bottom and top vents. The cooking space is perfect for our use. The best feature is the ease of cleaning. Work the bottom vents back and forth to move the ashes into the canister and then empty the canister. Very handy. One thing I don't particularly care about is the center removable piece on the grate. I know it's to support accessories but it is a little difficult to clean with a wire brush because the center piece won't stay in place when scrubbed. Overall - I'm very happy with the product.
Results.Title: Master-Touch Charcoal Grill 22"

Results.ReviewText: My Weber grill is the easily the best grill I’ve ever owned. I have grilled on it almost every weekend since I bought it. My family really enjoys the meals I prepare and I really enjoy trying new recipes and techniques with this simple yet effective grill. There really is no other brand that comes close. My favorite and easiest meal is chicken. Indirect heat and you don’t even need a cradle. Comes out perfect every time.

14501001.Name: 22” Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill
14501001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill. This grill features a handy Tuck-Away Lid Holder that gives you a convenient place to nest the lid against the side of the bowl, a hinged cooking grate that fits circular GBS accessories so you can explore more ways to cook, a built-in lid thermometer, and legs that are 2” taller than standard kettles. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retain heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate fits circular GBS grillware· Included Char-Rails make it easy to arrange charcoal· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Tuck-Away Lid Holder provides handy space to hang lid· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels.· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant and 2” taller· 10-year limited warranty
